facts.fact: The Public Procurement Service says 143 of its leaders and employees completed four courses of the national 5 Million Ethiopian Coders initiative, earning 427 certificates reported to the Federal Civil Service Commission.
The Public Procurement Service says the government's 5 Million Ethiopian Coders initiative was launched to give free digital training to five million citizens; no number trained nationally is given.

ETH.note: Only names Digital Ethiopia and the national digital transformation agenda; no standing, text or period stated.
